Introduction

Bae Jin Young, also known simply as Jinyoung, is a South Korean singer and actor under AURA Entertainment. He is a former member of the boy group CIX and the project group Wanna One. He is set to make his solo debut on October 14, 2025 with the mini album Still Young.

In 2017, Bae Jin Young participated in the second season of Mnet’s survival program Produce 101 as a trainee representing C9 Entertainment. He finished in 10th place and subsequently debuted as a member of Wanna One. The group officially debuted on August 7, 2017 with the mini album 1X1=1 (To Be One). Following the conclusion of their contract, Wanna One disbanded on January 27, 2019 after holding their final concert, Therefore.

On April 26, 2019, Bae Jin Young released his first solo single album Hard To Say Goodbye. Later that year, he debuted as a member of CIX on July 23 with the group’s first mini album Hello Chapter 1. Hello, Stranger. Expanding into acting, it was confirmed on July 30, 2021 that he would star as the male lead in the web drama User Not Found, which premiered in November. On August 4, 2024, reports revealed that Bae Jin Young had chosen not to renew his exclusive contract with C9 Entertainment. The following day, C9 confirmed that his contract had ended on August 1 and that he would depart from both the company and CIX. On December 6, 2024, he signed an exclusive contract with AURA Entertainment.

In 2025, it was first reported on August 1 that he would make his solo debut in September. On September 25, he officially announced that his first solo mini album, Still Young, would be released on October 14, marking the beginning of his solo career.
